# Favicon and PWA Assets

## Generated Files (October 10, 2025)

All icons generated from `logo-bm.png` with transparent background and 10% padding.

### Standard Favicons

- `favicon.ico` - Multi-size ICO file (279KB) for browser tabs
- `favicon-16x16.png` - 16x16 favicon
- `favicon-32x32.png` - 32x32 favicon
- `favicon-48x48.png` - 48x48 favicon
- `favicon-196.png` - 196x196 favicon (generated by pwa-asset-generator)

### Apple Touch Icons

- `apple-icon-180.png` - Apple touch icon (180x180) for iOS home screen

### Android Chrome Icons

- `android-chrome-192x192.png` - 192x192 Android icon
- `android-chrome-512x512.png` - 512x512 Android icon

### PWA Manifest Icons

- `manifest-icon-192.maskable.png` - 192x192 maskable icon for PWA
- `manifest-icon-512.maskable.png` - 512x512 maskable icon for PWA

### Microsoft Tile Icons

- `mstile-icon-128.png` - 128x128 MS tile
- `mstile-icon-270.png` - 270x270 MS tile
- `mstile-icon-558.png` - 558x558 MS tile
- `mstile-icon-558-270.png` - 558x270 MS tile

### Apple Splash Screens

40 splash screen images for various iOS devices (portrait and landscape orientations)

- Format: `apple-splash-{width}-{height}.jpg`
- Devices covered: iPhone SE to iPad Pro 12.9"

## Configuration Files

- `site.webmanifest` - PWA manifest with icon references and app metadata

## Backup

Old favicon files backed up to: `_icons_backup_20251010/`

## Usage in HTML

The favicons are referenced in `src/app/layout.tsx` metadata.
